node.statement: For the fixed W and any 0 <= epsilon <= W.epsilon_MAIN, put t_1=W.K1*epsilon. By lem-maincb-structural-domain-ledger, epsilon <= W.e1/W.K1 and 0 <= t_1 <= W.K_call*epsilon <= W.r_reset. Moreover W.K1 >= K_1^0 >= 1, so epsilon <= t_1. Thus both the Stage-1 producer and the global-target reset scale hypotheses hold.
